action_summary: Restore training on all original essays at natural score frequencies by removing topic downsampling, pre-CV SMOTE, and class balancing. Preserve the existing local transformer ensemble, cached features, selected n-grams, and 15-fold LightGBM pipeline; guarantee inclusion of the six transformer columns, derive objective moments from real labels, retain missing values consistently, and store floating-point OOF predictions. Add conservative two-parameter QWK rounding calibration, enabled only after cross-fitted improvement across at least four of five calibration splits. Align feature additions and final submission by essay_id. No training or inference was run; leaderboard improvement remains unverified without competition data. Checkpoint discovery is deterministic and restricted to model directories; QWK evaluation restores integer labels explicitly after target centering.
